item.title: When They Say It Takes A Village, They Also Mean Supporting Bosses
item.description: Read When They Say It Takes A Village, They Also Mean Supporting Bosses Manager: "[Coworker], are you drunk?" Coworker: "No, but I am sleep-deprived, and there's not much functional difference." Read When They Say It Takes A Village, They Also Mean Supporting Bosses

item.title: Have You Tried Not Being Ableist?
item.description: Read Have You Tried Not Being Ableist? Boss: "Why don’t you just control your ADHD? Just focus on the problem, it's easy!" Several people in the office laugh. One coworker says out loud: Coworker #1: "Why are you homeless? Just buy a house!" Read Have You Tried Not Being Ableist?

item.title: Supporting Your Tech Support
item.description: Read Supporting Your Tech Support Me: "Yes, ma'am, the cord is plugged in at both ends." Representative: "W-Wait... Did you actually just check the cord?" Me: "Yes? That's literally what you asked me to do; why wouldn't I?" Read Supporting Your Tech Support

item.title: Row-verruled
item.description: Read Row-verruled Girl: "Wait! I have an E-scooter!" Me: "Okay… and you have ID in the scooter?" Girl: "No, but they only give those to you if you're fourteen and up!" Read Row-verruled

item.title: Your Race Card Has Been Declined
item.description: Read Your Race Card Has Been Declined A customer comes in to collect a take-out order. As I'm bagging it up for her: Me: "And would you need utensils with that?" Customer: "Uh… yeah! What, you think we're just gonna eat this s*** with our hands?" Read Your Race Card Has Been Declined
